abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of pelvic midline cystic mass in a female fetus without visibility of the rectum and which is not a cloacal anomaly. METHODS: Ultrasound (US) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) were performed respectively at 27 and 27.5 weeks' gestation and the findings of these examinations were compared with post-mortem examination after termination of pregnancy (TOP). RESULTS: US showed a pelvic midline cystic mass in a female fetus with mild enlargement of the left ureter and renal pelvis. MRI did not show the T1 hypersignal of meconium in the rectum. The analysis of MR findings were suggestive of the diagnosis of a sacrococcygeal teratoma. Pregnancy was terminated because of the possibility of severe sphincterial disorders and the fetopathological examination confirmed this diagnosis. CONCLUSION: This observation illustrates the diagnostic problems generated by the detection of a pelvic midline cystic mass in a female fetus. The absence of visibility of the T1 hypersignal of the meconium in the rectum is traditionally supposed to be highly suggestive of a cloaca, but may also be explained by the emptiness of the rectum, compressed by the mass.
abstract_ja:
目的：直腸が描出されず、クロアカ奇形ではない女児胎児の骨盤正中嚢胞性腫瘤の症例を報告すること。
方法：27週および27.5週で超音波検査（US）と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を施行し、これらの所見を中絶後の剖検所見と比較した。
結果：超音波検査で、女児胎児の骨盤正中嚢胞性腫瘤と左尿管・腎盂の軽度拡張を認めた。MRIでは直腸内メコニウムのT1高信号を認めなかった。MRI所見から仙尾部奇形腫が示唆され、重度の括約筋障害の可能性があるため妊娠を中絶した。胎児の病理組織検査でこの診断が確認された。
結論：本症例は、骨盤正中の嚢胞性腫瘤を胎児期に検出した際の診断上の問題点を示している。直腸内メコニウムのT1高信号が見えないことは、伝統的にクロアカを強く示唆するとされてきたが、腫瘤によって直腸が圧迫され空虚になっていることでも説明しうる。
